Hi team — attaching our proposed redline to HealthBridge's DPA (Redline_DPA_2026-03-23.docx). Summary of material positions we changed:

- Purpose & Scope: Scoped HIPAA processing to named products and accepted customer-defined categories for PHI (Section 2).
